profile.headline: Humanoids Software Engineer
profile.summary:
As an AI and ML Developer at Unlimited Robotics, I work on cutting-edge projects that combine computer vision, natural language processing, and artificial intelligence to create innovative solutions for various domains. I use Python, C/C++, and ROS/ROS2 to develop and implement algorithms, models, and systems that enable robots to interact with humans and the environment in natural and intuitive ways.

I graduated from Universidad Santo Tomás Colombia with a degree in Electronic Engineering in June 2021. During my studies, I participated in several robotics competitions and events, such as RoboCup 2019 in Sydney, where I was a software developer for the RoboCup @Home team. I also won the second prize in the Expresa tu Ingenio contest, where I presented a precision agriculture project using drones. I am passionate about robotics and AI, and I am always eager to learn new skills and technologies that can enhance my work and research.

honors.title: The second prize-winner of the Expresa tu Ingenio
honors.description:
Precision agriculture using drones:
The Colombian Society of Engineers (SCI) and the Colombian Association of Engineering Faculties (ACOFI) present to the country the I National Exhibition of Undergraduate Projects in Engineering: Express your Ingenuity. An initiative that seeks to recognize the best work done by engineering students in Colombia at the end of their undergraduate studies, which constitute projects of high value for the development of the country.
honors.issuer: Issued by The Colombian Association of Engineering Faculties (ACOFI) · Nov 2019
